name: diagnostic-dofile
description: | Use this skill when the user needs to inspect, audit, or diagnose the safety of a Stata do-file. Typical scenarios include: uncertainty about whether a .do file is safe; receiving a complete do-file from an unofficial source (not the Stata website, not a well-known academic institution or professor's official site); asking to check a batch of do-files; or requesting a read-only security/risk/portability diagnostic report. The skill does not modify the original file; it only emits a JSON report
author: SepineTam
